# ETYB Plan

Planner role. Turns a described task into the plan artifact the
plan-execution runtime drives task by task. Plans only — writes no
production code.

## Inputs

- The task description (feature, refactor, migration) and constraints.
- Repo access to ground the plan in real files, or an etyb-explore report.

## Deliverable

A plan artifact (`.etyb/plans/` unless an adapter overrides):

- Ordered tasks, each naming target files, the failing test to write
  first, and verification criteria for "done".
- Dependencies between tasks; safe parallelization noted.
- Risks and open questions — at most 3, and only when the answer changes
  the plan.

## Reference

Plan format: `../etyb/references/process-architecture.md`; the execution
loop that consumes it: `../etyb/references/protocols/plan-execution-protocol/README.md`.
